# netskope_npa_private_app_tag (Resource)

NPAPrivateAppTag Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netskope_npa_private_app_tag" "my_npaprivateapptag" {
  tag_name = "...my_tag_name..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag_name` (String) Tag name. Must be unique per tenant. The hook wraps this in the {"tags": [...]} envelope required by the POST API.

### Read-Only

- `tag_id` (Number) Tag ID

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netskope_npa_private_app_tag.my_netskope_npa_private_app_tag
  id = 0
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netskope_npa_private_app_tag.my_netskope_npa_private_app_tag 0
```
